entry.title: Share codes: send a modpack to a friend
entry.content: Use Export - Share Modpack to copy a share code for an instance, and Add Instance - Share Code to install it on another launcher. The code records the exact Minecraft version, mod loader and mod files, and you can mark which mods players need to join your server. See the README for the full steps.

entry.title: Welcome to PohonMC
entry.content: PohonMC is a fork of PineconeMC, which is itself a fork of Prism Launcher. It keeps Ely.by account support and adds share-code modpack sharing. Downloads and documentation are on the PohonMC site, and bug reports are welcome on GitHub.
